Orissa High Court Imposes Costs for Habeas Corpus Misuse in Marital Dispute

The Orissa High Court imposed a cost of ₹50,000 on a husband for filing a habeas corpus petition in a marital dispute, stating that a wife cannot be treated as chattel. The court criticized the misuse of habeas corpus in such cases. This ruling highlights the judiciary's stance against treating spouses as property and the improper use of legal remedies.
